transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I've called us together for the weekly logistics huddle ahead of today's scheduled lift. We have two available pallet positions on the aircraft, and only one of those positions provides continuous electrical power during flight. I see three approved cargoes staged for consideration: medical vaccine cases, an avionics diagnostic module, and water-purification cartridges. Before I sign off on the final pallet allocation and loading instructions, I need each of your input on cargo handling and coordination requirements. Let's start with what your sections know about these cargoes and any constraints I need to be aware of.
